category_title: Middle school student with cerebral palsy and orthopedic impairment exhibiting self-injurious behavior and verbal outbursts
student_description: Jason is a middle school student with physical and cognitive disabilities who exhibits self-injurious behaviors, verbal outbursts, and self-stimulation when isolated, waiting, or pressured by unfamiliar adults. He uniquely requires peer-mediated support, age-appropriate materials, and modified shared curriculum to prevent isolation and facilitate meaningful participation.

criteria.rationale: As a middle schooler, Jason requires grade-level, age-appropriate materials to maintain meaningful engagement and dignity.
criteria.check: The tutor's long-term plan utilizes middle-school-appropriate topics and materials (e.g., articles on culture or science) rather than early childhood or overly simplified books.

criteria.rationale: Providing unrelated special education activities isolates Jason; he needs the general education curriculum modified to his level to remain part of the class.
criteria.check: The tutor's plan adapts the shared classroom curriculum for Jason rather than assigning him a completely separate, unrelated activity.

criteria.rationale: Jason replaces self-injurious and self-stimulatory behaviors with appropriate communication when he has continuous opportunities to observe and model non-disabled peers.
criteria.check: The tutor's plan structurally embeds Jason with general education peers for the full duration of classes and transitions, explicitly avoiding late arrivals, early departures, or physical isolation.
